exemplars.question: Berapa total transaksi dan ringkasan status pembayaran bulan ini?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e12, 4) as volume_triliun FROM transactions GROUP BY status

exemplars.question: Berapa total nilai GMV kuartal ini dan rata-rata per transaksi?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e12, 4) as gmv_triliun, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(amount), 0) as avg_amount FROM transactions WHERE status='SUCCESS'

exemplars.question: Tampilkan distribusi volume transaksi per kanal pembayaran
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as volume_miliar, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY channel ORDER BY total_tx DESC

exemplars.question: Kategori bisnis apa yang memiliki volume transaksi terbanyak?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT merchant_category, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as volume_miliar FROM transactions GROUP BY merchant_category ORDER BY volume_miliar DESC

exemplars.question: Berapa success rate vs failure rate secara keseluruhan?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/5000000, 2) as percentage FROM transactions GROUP BY status

exemplars.question: Bagaimana tren transaksi per bulan dari Juli sampai September 2026?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m') as bulan, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e12, 4) as volume_triliun FROM transactions GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

exemplars.question: Tunjukkan linimasa transaksi harian khusus kanal VA BCA di bulan September 2026
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as tgl, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions WHERE channel='VA_BCA' AND strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m')='2026-09' GROUP BY tgl ORDER BY tgl

exemplars.question: Pada jam berapa tingkat kegagalan transaksi paling tinggi terjadi?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM timestamp) as jam, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY jam ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 10

exemplars.question: Bandingkan volume transaksi hari kerja vs akhir pekan
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM timestamp) IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END as day_type, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY day_type

exemplars.question: Bagaimana performa metode pembayaran 7 hari terakhir bulan September?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions WHERE strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2026-09-24' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC

exemplars.question: Kanal pembayaran mana yang memiliki failure rate tertinggi?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as total_tx, SUM(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY channel ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC

exemplars.question: Apa saja rincian kode error penyebab kegagalan transaksi pada VA BCA?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT failure_code, COUNT(*) as total_failed FROM transactions WHERE channel='VA_BCA' AND status='FAILED' GROUP BY failure_code ORDER BY total_failed DESC

exemplars.question: Kapan spike kegagalan tertinggi terjadi pada VA BCA?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as tgl, COUNT(*) as failed_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions WHERE channel='VA_BCA' GROUP BY tgl ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 5

exemplars.question: Berapa total nominal transaksi yang mengalami timeout ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_timeout, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as total_nominal_miliar FROM transactions WHERE failure_code='ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT'

exemplars.question: Apa penyebab utama kegagalan transaksi kartu kredit di akhir pekan?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT failure_code, COUNT(*) as count FROM transactions WHERE channel='CREDIT_CARD' AND status='FAILED' AND EXTRACT(dow FROM timestamp) IN (0, 6) GROUP BY failure_code ORDER BY count DESC

exemplars.question: Berapa transaksi gagal dengan nominal di atas 10 juta rupiah?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as high_val_failures, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as nominal_miliar FROM transactions WHERE amount >= 10000000 AND status='FAILED' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY high_val_failures DESC

exemplars.question: Kategori merchant mana yang memiliki rasio kegagalan transaksi tertinggi?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT merchant_category, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY merchant_category ORDER BY fail_rate_pct DESC

exemplars.question: Berapa volume transaksi berstatus FAILED pada Bank Mandiri?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_failed, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as failed_volume_miliar FROM transactions WHERE channel='VA_MANDIRI' AND status='FAILED'

exemplars.question: Bagaimana performa transaksi QRIS Gopay dibandingkan e-wallet lainnya?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as total_tx, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions WHERE channel IN ('QRIS_GOPAY', 'EWALLET_OVO') GROUP BY channel

exemplars.question: Urutkan merchant category berdasarkan total nominal perputaran uang
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT merchant_category, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e12, 4) as gmv_triliun, COUNT(*) as total_tx FROM transactions GROUP BY merchant_category ORDER BY gmv_triliun DESC

exemplars.question: Berapa transaksi VA BCA yang gagal dengan status ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT antara tanggal 12 dan 15 September 2026?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as tgl, COUNT(*) as timeout_tx, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as volume_miliar FROM transactions WHERE channel='VA_BCA' AND failure_code='ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT' AND strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN '2026-09-12' AND '2026-09-15' GROUP BY tgl ORDER BY tgl

exemplars.question: Tampilkan 5 tanggal dengan nilai transaksi gagal terbesar dalam rupiah
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as tgl, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e9, 2) as failed_miliar, COUNT(*) as failed_count FROM transactions WHERE status='FAILED' GROUP BY tgl ORDER BY failed_miliar DESC LIMIT 5

exemplars.question: Berapa total GMV sukses untuk masing-masing kategori bisnis?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT merchant_category, ROUND(SUM(amount)/1e12, 4) as success_triliun FROM transactions WHERE status='SUCCESS' GROUP BY merchant_category ORDER BY success_triliun DESC

exemplars.question: Berapa pangsa pasar persentase volume tiap kanal terhadap total transaksi?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(COUNT(*)*100.0/5000000, 2) as tx_share_pct, ROUND(SUM(amount)*100.0/1014758721700.0, 2) as vol_share_pct FROM transactions GROUP BY channel ORDER BY tx_share_pct DESC

exemplars.question: Berapa persentase kegagalan transaksi harian selama bulan September 2026?
exemplars.verified_sql: SELECT strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as tgl, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100, 2) as fail_rate_pct FROM transactions WHERE strftime(timestamp, '%Y-%m')='2026-09' GROUP BY tgl ORDER BY tgl
